A discounter intends to take as many small profits as possible. This is the opposite of the "let your profits run" mindset, which attempts to optimize positive trading results by increasing the size of winning trades.

Scalping: Small Quick Profits Can Add Up
The main premises of scalping are:

Lessened exposure limits risk: A brief exposure to the market diminishes the probability of running into an adverse event.
Smaller moves are easier to obtain: A bigger imbalance of supply and demand is needed to warrant bigger price changes. 

Spreads in Scalping vs. Normal Trading Strategy
When scalpers trade, they want to profit off the changes in a security's bid-ask spread. 

But in normal circumstances, trading is fairly consistent and can allow for steady profits. That's because the spread between the bid and the ask is also steady (supply and demand for securities is balanced).

Scalping as a Primary Trading Style
A pure scalper will make a number of trades each day—perhaps in the hundreds. A scalper will mostly utilize tick, or one-minute charts, since the time frame is small, and they need to see the setups as they take shape as close to real-time as possible. Supporting systems such as Direct Access Trading (DAT) and Level 2 quotations are essential for this type of trading. Automatic, instant execution of orders is crucial to a scalper, so a direct-access broker is the preferred method.

Welcome to my live Gold (XAUUSD) trading session.
Here, I actively trade Gold, Forex, and Crypto, while engaging in informative discussions on key trading topics like risk management, psychology, and strategy. These insights are especially valuable for new traders who are building their trading foundation.

Market Overview
On Thursday, XAUUSD formed a bullish candle, reaching a high of 4143 and a low of 4030. Over the last week, the market showed bearish momentum, touching a high of 4220 and a low of 3959, with the weekly candle closing at 4088.

Technical Outlook
Resistance Levels
$4,580 – $4,620 → Recent all-time high zone / strong supply reaction 
$4,700 – $4,800 → Breakout continuation targets (institutional forecasts) 
$4,900+ → Major psychological & long-term institutional zone 

Support Levels
$4,500 – $4,520 → Immediate support / breakout retest zone 
$4,400 – $4,420 → Mid-channel support & prior swing structure 
$4,300 – $4,350 → Key demand zone / strong buyer defense

Outlook
Medium Term (1–4 Weeks):
Bullish bias remains intact as long as price holds above $4,300 – $4,350, maintaining higher highs and higher lows. 
Upside scenario: Sustained momentum and macro tailwinds (rate expectations, safe-haven demand) could drive price toward $4,700 – $4,800+. 
Bearish risk: A confirmed breakdown below $4,100 – $4,200 would weaken structure and likely trigger a deeper correction toward $4,000 – $4,050.

Long Term (2025–2026):
The long-term trend remains bullish with strong macro support — central bank buying, rate-cut expectations, geopolitical pressures all supportive.
Major forecasts see higher regime pricing into late 2026 — potentially reaching $4,800–$5,000+ or above.

Advice for Beginners
Before diving into my trading strategy, I want to emphasize a core principle:
Your first priority as a Forex trader should be capital preservation. Only after mastering how to protect your capital should you aim to generate profits. Once you're consistently profitable, then — and only then — should you aim for wealth building or financial freedom through trading. If you skip directly to chasing riches, you’ll likely face disappointment and losses.

Understanding the Nature of Forex
The Forex market is highly unpredictable, and no strategy is 100% profitable.
My success is grounded in three critical areas:
• Risk Management
• Psychological Discipline
• Emotional Control
I may face losses within a session or even a day, but rarely across a week or a month. That’s the rhythm of a seasoned trader, and it’s part of what makes Forex so exciting and rewarding.

My Trading Strategy
✅ Semi-Automated Trading
Trading in a volatile market like Forex requires more than just analysis — it demands emotional discipline, which is difficult to maintain manually.
That’s why I use a hybrid approach combining human internevtion with my Expert Advisor (EA).
• This EA is designed to identify ideal entries in both trending and sideways markets, based on live fundamental conditions — not daily technical signals.
• It works in both Buy and Sell directions and automatically manages Take Profit (TP), Stop Loss (SL), and Breakeven levels.
• This setup makes my trading more efficient and removes much of the emotional pressure.
• I continuously upgrade the EA to improve performance and adapt to changing markets.

✅ I Trade All Sessions
While the New York session and session overlaps provide higher volume and volatility, I stay active in all trading sessions. Great opportunities can appear at any time, and I remain prepared to seize them.

✅ Multiple Positions in the Same Direction
When I identify a strong setup, I open multiple positions with:
• Same Lot Size
• Same Stop Loss
• Different Take Profits
One of the positions is often left with an open TP to capture larger market moves.
Yes, stop losses may hit in a row at times, but my cumulative TPs always outweigh the SLs — and that’s what keeps my strategy profitable over the long run.

✅ Breakeven After Partial Profits
Once one or two TPs hit, I adjust the SL of all remaining positions to Breakeven.
• Sometimes, the market retraces, hits breakeven, and then resumes in my original direction.
• In such cases, I don’t immediately re-enter in the same direction. Instead, I wait patiently — even for a few hours — until a valid setup appears in the opposite direction. Only then do I take my next entry.

This structured approach allows me to trade consistently, reduce risk, and capitalize on market momentum — while maintaining control and discipline every step of the way.

title: Live Gold (XAUUSD) Trading & Technical Analysis - My Gold Trading Strategy
description:
Welcome to my live Gold (XAUUSD) trading session.
Here, I actively trade Gold, Forex, and Crypto, while engaging in informative discussions on key trading topics like risk management, psychology, and strategy. These insights are especially valuable for new traders who are building their trading foundation.

Market Overview
On Thursday, XAUUSD formed a bullish candle, reaching a high of 4143 and a low of 4030. Over the last week, the market showed bearish momentum, touching a high of 4220 and a low of 3959, with the weekly candle closing at 4088.

Technical Outlook
Resistance Levels
$4,580 – $4,620 → Recent all-time high zone / strong supply reaction 
$4,700 – $4,800 → Breakout continuation targets (institutional forecasts) 
$4,900+ → Major psychological & long-term institutional zone 

Support Levels
$4,500 – $4,520 → Immediate support / breakout retest zone 
$4,400 – $4,420 → Mid-channel support & prior swing structure 
$4,300 – $4,350 → Key demand zone / strong buyer defense

Outlook
Medium Term (1–4 Weeks):
Bullish bias remains intact as long as price holds above $4,300 – $4,350, maintaining higher highs and higher lows. 
Upside scenario: Sustained momentum and macro tailwinds (rate expectations, safe-haven demand) could drive price toward $4,700 – $4,800+. 
Bearish risk: A confirmed breakdown below $4,100 – $4,200 would weaken structure and likely trigger a deeper correction toward $4,000 – $4,050.

Long Term (2025–2026):
The long-term trend remains bullish with strong macro support — central bank buying, rate-cut expectations, geopolitical pressures all supportive.
Major forecasts see higher regime pricing into late 2026 — potentially reaching $4,800–$5,000+ or above.

Advice for Beginners
Before diving into my trading strategy, I want to emphasize a core principle:
Your first priority as a Forex trader should be capital preservation. Only after mastering how to protect your capital should you aim to generate profits. Once you're consistently profitable, then — and only then — should you aim for wealth building or financial freedom through trading. If you skip directly to chasing riches, you’ll likely face disappointment and losses.

Understanding the Nature of Forex
The Forex market is highly unpredictable, and no strategy is 100% profitable.
My success is grounded in three critical areas:
• Risk Management
• Psychological Discipline
• Emotional Control
I may face losses within a session or even a day, but rarely across a week or a month. That’s the rhythm of a seasoned trader, and it’s part of what makes Forex so exciting and rewarding.

My Trading Strategy
✅ Semi-Automated Trading
Trading in a volatile market like Forex requires more than just analysis — it demands emotional discipline, which is difficult to maintain manually.
That’s why I use a hybrid approach combining human internevtion with my Expert Advisor (EA).
• This EA is designed to identify ideal entries in both trending and sideways markets, based on live fundamental conditions — not daily technical signals.
• It works in both Buy and Sell directions and automatically manages Take Profit (TP), Stop Loss (SL), and Breakeven levels.
• This setup makes my trading more efficient and removes much of the emotional pressure.
• I continuously upgrade the EA to improve performance and adapt to changing markets.

✅ I Trade All Sessions
While the New York session and session overlaps provide higher volume and volatility, I stay active in all trading sessions. Great opportunities can appear at any time, and I remain prepared to seize them.

✅ Multiple Positions in the Same Direction
When I identify a strong setup, I open multiple positions with:
• Same Lot Size
• Same Stop Loss
• Different Take Profits
One of the positions is often left with an open TP to capture larger market moves.
Yes, stop losses may hit in a row at times, but my cumulative TPs always outweigh the SLs — and that’s what keeps my strategy profitable over the long run.

✅ Breakeven After Partial Profits
Once one or two TPs hit, I adjust the SL of all remaining positions to Breakeven.
• Sometimes, the market retraces, hits breakeven, and then resumes in my original direction.
• In such cases, I don’t immediately re-enter in the same direction. Instead, I wait patiently — even for a few hours — until a valid setup appears in the opposite direction. Only then do I take my next entry.

This structured approach allows me to trade consistently, reduce risk, and capitalize on market momentum — while maintaining control and discipline every step of the way.

title: Lhasa Apso Dog Breed Guide
description: #lhasaapso dogs. What  are they really like to live with? Here, an owner whose Lhasa Apso was crowned Best in Show Champion at the UK's premier dog show, Crufts tells all. You'll find out about the temperament of these popular small dogs. They may be reluctant to make friends and can be wary of strangers - perhaps something to do with their origins listening out for intruders in the monasteries of Tibet. But once you've won them over - they'll fit into most families and become an excellent pet. Our video also includes detailed advice on pretty demanding routine for #lhasaapsogrooming - as well as options to have them clipped into short coats. A Kennel Club trainer advises on the type of training that's needed for #lhasaapsopuppies to prepare these dogs for lifelong grooming routine.  As always, do add your own comments about your experiences of living with Lhasa Apsos. They are a very intuitive breed. Very intelligent and intuitive. They know what you're thinking before you think it. They're very peaceful dogs. I just think they're a fabulous breed to live with. Different to a lot of other breeds. They originate from Lhasa in Tibet and they were the hearing dogs of the Tibetan monks within the monasteries. So they have very acute hearing, and they would hear somebody coming many miles away and they would bark and let the Tibetan Mastifs - which were the outside guard dogs - know that somebody was coming. These can be a bit like that at times. They don't particularly like strangers but they're not yappy. They're not a yappy breed. They are a little bit wary of  strangers and choosy about who they make friends with. If you have a really busy household, they may not be the ideal dog for you. They're a compact dog and in the right environment will make an ideal family pet. They're not specifically bothered about lots of exercise. I think a nice garden is nice for them, and people can just go and play in the garden or if the owner really likes walking, they will like walking and walk with you. Of if you want to go and play over the fields with them they would love that too. It depends on the individual, but they're not like a larger breed that needs lots of exercise. If they grow up with children, like most dogs, they get used to children. If the children are well monitored by adults, which they should be when around puppies and dogs, then they'll get on absolutely fine. They love children. I've got grandchildren and mine love the grandchildren. And they get on well with other dogs. They just think - Oh, they're other dogs, and pass them by. They're a bit snooty. When thinking of a Lhasa Apso, the first thing I've got to think about is early training and getting it used to be handled. It's got a lot of coat which is going to need a lot of grooming So you need to get your puppy used to having its face, its paws, its back end - all of it handled in a really nice manner. You need to find a groomer that does it like that as well. You need a groomer who will let you take a puppy in, get it used to the environment, and handled with lots and lots of positive re-enforecement. You want grooming to be a fabulous experience because it's going to be groomed for a long time. Lahsa Apsos are designed to withstand the cold temperatures in Tibet so they have a very dense coat which can require a good deal of grooming if it's to be kept in good condition. People that have them as a pet and want to grow their hair long, there is a lot of work involvement in keeping this hair beautful like this. But they can be clipped into what we call a Puppy Trim. And they look really pretty. They're eternal puppies then. It's easier to keep. But they still do need grooming attention even if they're trimmed. They will need bathing quite regularly and they need grooming quite regularly.

In this video, we are counting down the top 10 facts about the Lhasa Apso that you might not know. 

A Quick Overview: 
Group: Companion Dogs
Weight: 12 to 15 pounds
Height: 9 to 11 inches tall at the shoulder
Life Expectancy: 12 - 15 years

The Lhasa Apso thinks he's a large dog, a very large dog. Bred for hundreds of years to be a royal watchdog, the modern Lhasa approaches life the way his forebears did: he is a loyal guardian of home and family. The Lhasa's protective nature can surprise those unfamiliar with him, given his small size and long, flowing coat. He certainly doesn't appear fierce.

But when it comes to protecting his own, the Lhasa is fierce, though never unusually aggressive. He's naturally suspicious of strangers — an excellent trait for a palace guard — and he takes his job as protector seriously. The lionhearted Lhasa's devotion also means he enjoys sharing life with his family. He's intelligent, independent (a watchdog must think on his own), and mischievous.

If you are considering a Lhasa — and many find his looks irresistible — you must consider this breed's protective nature. Early socialization and training are absolutely critical to a Lhasa's success as a family member so that he can properly direct his natural tendency toward wariness. The time invested in training him, however, is well worth your effort in terms of the loyalty, joy, and companionship that this long-lived, hardy little dog provides.

The Lhasa likes doing his own thing, which means his goal in life is not necessarily to please you. In this, he differs from such breeds as the biddable Labrador Retriever. While the Lhasa can be trained successfully, he is not always the most obedient dog in the class. But those who know and love the Lhasa praise his smarts and unique ability to reason. He can even tend toward manipulation, so consistency is key in training the Lhasa pup (just as it is with raising children). If you don't take charge, your Lhasa will certainly try.

La causa por el vaciamiento y la posterior expropiación de YPF sufre un giro histórico tras la decisión de la Cámara Federal de aceptar como querellante a la sociedad civil, quebrando un blindaje judicial de veinte años.El expediente penal, que permaneció inmóvil durante dos décadas bajo la órbita del Juzgado Federal Número 4 liderado por el juez Ariel Lijo, enfrenta una etapa decisiva. La parálisis sistemática de esta investigación es analizada como una decisión política encubierta bajo la burocracia judicial, que sirvió como amparo directo a los sectores responsables del despojo patrimonial.La estatización de la petrolera en 2012, impulsada por el entonces viceministro de Economía, Axel Kicillof, desencadenó un fallo multimillonario adverso en los tribunales de Nueva York debido a la flagrante violación de los estatutos de la compañía. Mientras el descalabro financiero impactaba las finanzas públicas, en los despachos de Comodoro Py se tejió un manto de impunidad que evitó determinar responsabilidades penales.Con la resolución unánime de la Cámara Federal, que revoca el criterio de Lijo e incorpora a la entidad civil "Integridad Republicana" como querellante, se devuelve el acceso al expediente y la potestad de proponer medidas de prueba clave. José Urrutia presenta su columna de análisis profundo para la Central de Noticias, detallando cómo la irrupción de la sociedad civil jaquea un pacto de complicidad explícita con el poder político.  #CausaYPF #AxelKicillof #JuezLijo #ComodoroPy #PoliticaArgentina #Justicia

📢 FALLO HISTÓRICO A FAVOR DE YPF: ARGENTINA EVITA PAGAR 18.000 MILLONES DE DÓLARES
description:
👉 En un hecho considerado histórico, la Cámara de Apelaciones de Estados Unidos decidió revertir el fallo emitido por la jueza Loretta Preska, que había condenado a Argentina a pagar 16 mil millones de dólares más intereses a accionistas afectados por la estatización de YPF. El tribunal dio lugar al argumento argentino sobre la preeminencia entre el Estatuto de la Empresa y la Ley de Estatización, inclinándose finalmente por esta última.

El proceso judicial se originó tras denuncias sobre irregularidades en el proceso de estatización y supuesta violación del estatuto corporativo. La decisión evita que Argentina tenga que desembolsar una suma considerada como uno de los juicios más costosos y complejos enfrentados por el país. Además, se destaca que el tribunal tomó en cuenta argumentos presentados desde el gobierno anterior respecto a la jurisdicción adecuada para este litigio.

El presidente Javier Milei celebró públicamente el fallo en redes sociales, calificándolo como "el mayor logro jurídico de la historia nacional" y asegurando que "todo marcha según lo planeado". Si bien queda abierta la posibilidad para los demandantes de acudir a la Corte Suprema estadounidense, expertos consideran difícil que sea aceptado debido al rigor del proceso. La noticia fue recibida con alivio y optimismo tanto por funcionarios como por analistas locales.

Con proyecciones inéditas de rentabilidad operativa para 2026, agencias como Morgan Stanley y Fitch Ratings respaldan el futuro de la compañía.

El presidente de YPF destacó que este proyecto representa una inversión extranjera sin precedentes, calculada en 25 mil millones de dólares solo en infraestructura, a lo que se suman otros 15 mil millones para pozos y operaciones relacionadas.

El objetivo es que Argentina logre exportar más de 30 mil millones de dólares anuales a partir de 2031, duplicando así la producción promedio actual de gas en Vaca Muerta. "La producción que vamos a exportar significa duplicar la producción promedio de vaca muerta del año pasado", afirmó el directivo. Se prevé perforar unos 800 pozos y generar alrededor de 50.000 puestos de trabajo directos e indirectos hasta el año 2030.

Este acuerdo marca un hito tras años de negociaciones y desafíos para atraer inversiones al sector energético argentino. Además, se espera que tenga un impacto económico comparable al sector agroexportador nacional durante las próximas dos décadas, consolidando a Vaca Muerta como motor clave del crecimiento económico argentino.

description:

El respaldo estadounidense generó una reacción positiva en los mercados: las acciones de YPF subieron un 5% tras conocerse la noticia. Además, se enfatizó que este apoyo fortalece las relaciones políticas entre ambos países y mejora la percepción internacional sobre Argentina. description:
#argentina #estadosunidos #juicio #ypf 

[00:02] ⚖️ Fallo histórico en EE.UU. favorece a Argentina por estatización de YPF.
[01:18] 🔄 Corte de Nueva York anula fallo previo que obligaba a Argentina a pagar a World For Capital.
[03:14] 🇺🇸 Gobierno estadounidense interviene a favor de Argentina en la causa judicial.
[04:07] 📈 Argentina actual cambia su imagen incumplidora por una política pro occidental y honesta.
[04:53] 🌎 EE.UU. prioriza América Latina en su estrategia de seguridad nacional.
[05:25] 🚫 Castigos a países alineados con rivales de EE.UU., recompensas a aliados.
[07:04] 🔄 Cambio de época en América Latina: alineamiento con EE.UU. vs. confrontación esperando apoyo de China/Rusia.

Darío Mizrahi analiza un fallo histórico de la justicia de Estados Unidos que favorece a la República Argentina respecto a la estatización de YPF. Este hecho es presentado no solo desde un enfoque técnico-jurídico sino también desde una perspectiva geopolítica. Se destaca que, en los últimos 20 años, la relación entre Argentina y la justicia estadounidense ha sido conflictiva, con múltiples sentencias adversas, como en el caso de los fondos buitre. Sin embargo, esta vez la Corte del Segundo Distrito de Nueva York anuló un fallo previo que obligaba a Argentina a pagar una suma significativa a un fondo litigante, World For Capital, que representaba a accionistas minoritarios afectados por la expropiación de YPF.

El video resalta la inédita intervención del gobierno estadounidense en favor de Argentina, una señal política importante que refleja un cambio en la relación bilateral. Se contextualiza este fallo en el marco de una Argentina que actualmente busca honrar sus compromisos financieros y se muestra como un país pro occidental y pro estadounidense, contrastando con su imagen anterior de incumplimientos y manipulación estadística. Además, se menciona que Estados Unidos ha puesto a América Latina como prioridad en su estrategia de seguridad nacional, castigando a países que se alinean con sus rivales y recompensando a aquellos que siguen su liderazgo.

Finalmente, se subraya que este fallo es parte de un cambio de época en América Latina, donde los países enfrentan la disyuntiva de confrontar a Estados Unidos esperando apoyo de China y Rusia, o alinearse con Washington para obtener beneficios. Javier Milei y su gobierno han optado por este último camino, lo cual coincide con el momento del fallo favorable a Argentina, que implica un alivio económico importante para el país.

title: 🚨 Histórico: Argentina gana el juicio por YPF y no pagará US$18.000 millones | DNews
description:
#argentina #juicio #ypf #estadosunidos 

[01:21] 🎉 La Cámara de Apelaciones de Nueva York revoca la condena que obligaba a Argentina a pagar 16 mil millones.
[01:57] ⚖️ El fallo destaca que no existió obligación contractual bilateral entre Argentina y los accionistas minoritarios.
[04:37] 💰 La deuda reclamada ascendió a 18 mil millones con intereses, cifra similar al préstamo del FMI en 2024.
[05:00] 🤝 La intervención del gobierno de EE.UU. como amicus curiae fue clave para el fallo favorable a Argentina.
[06:35] 🛢️ YPF lidera un récord en exportación petrolera, impulsada por el yacimiento de Vaca Muerta.
[07:45] 🏛️ La expropiación parcial de 2012, liderada por Axel Kicillof, generó el litigio internacional.
[10:08] 📢 El caso es seguido de cerca por expertos y analistas internacionales, destacando su importancia histórica.

La Justicia de Estados Unidos, a través de un fallo de segunda instancia de la Corte de Apelaciones de Nueva York, absolvió a Argentina en el juicio por la expropiación de YPF, eximiendo al país de pagar los aproximadamente 18 mil millones que reclamaban los accionistas afectados desde la estatización en 2012. Este juicio había iniciado tras una demanda de Buffer Capital, empresa que compró el juicio a accionistas de YPF que se sintieron perjudicados. La primera instancia, a cargo de la jueza Loreta Presca, había ordenado el pago de 16 mil millones, cifra que con intereses ascendió a 18 mil millones, un monto cercano al préstamo del FMI en 2024.

El fallo de segunda instancia revocó esa condena por dos motivos: primero, porque el estatuto de YPF no generó obligaciones contractuales bilaterales entre Argentina y los accionistas minoritarios; y segundo, porque aún si existiera un contrato, la ley argentina de expropiación excluye demandas por daños y perjuicios en este contexto. El proceso de expropiación fue parcial, ya que el Estado compró solo el 51% de las acciones de Repsol, el accionista mayoritario, sin ofrecer adquirir el resto a otros accionistas, lo que generó el conflicto legal.

Se destacó la influencia positiva del gobierno argentino y la intervención del gobierno estadounidense como amicus curiae, apoyando la posición argentina. Este fallo es histórico y representa un alivio significativo para el Estado y para YPF, que además está en un momento de crecimiento exportador gracias al desarrollo de Vaca Muerta. La resolución abre paso a un horizonte más favorable para atraer inversiones y consolida la estabilidad jurídica de YPF, la empresa más importante de Argentina.

title: A WEEK ALONE 🏡 | No Friends | No Family | Rest - Reset | Work from home | Sobering | Journaling 🤍
description:
Do you ever feel like life just keeps going? there’s always a rush, always an activity, always an event, always a human interaction, life gets too exciting for too long….
That’s exactly what life in Lagos feels like, it’s so easy to get lost in the chase and even forget what you’re chasing. 

I decided to take this week off, off the noise, off the interdependency, off overly relying on love and comfort from family and friends, off giving, off giving myself - the last week of May felt like I was giving myself a lot more than I was giving to myself.

It was the first day of June, the last month of the first half of the year. I decided to halt everything, I needed me time, I did things I had been pushing back for months, I nearly cleared out my to-do list for the first time in a very long time. When the weekend came, I took sometime to reflect and yap a little bit with y’all, the refreshed feeling was too good to hide, seeing my energy charge up in real time is my favourite part of this vlog, what’s yours?

I hope you get to give to yourself more, it’s the only way you’ll have enough to give to others.

Xoxo

description:

So I took time off everything for a while, nobody knew I was back so I could just enjoy the quiet, and when the weekend came, I decided to remind myself of the fun life I live here and this is home.

Everyone sees the fun side of traveling to multiple cities and hardly being home but nobody really talks about the feeling of displacement it brings, especially in your youth; having an active life, building multiple businesses, getting a degree whilst creating for your community. If your child is not meeting milestones, let your pediatrician know and call early intervention for your state. Your child may qualify for free or low cost therapies such as speech therapy, occupational therapy and physical therapy. title: Building a Sweet Marriage/Family||Pastor Sarah Omakwu  || FIRST SERVICE || 14062026
description:
Genesis 2:18-25; Matthew 19:3-9; Ephesians 5:21-31; Phillipians 2:1-4
If you follow the scripture, you will have a sweet home. Marriage is looking out for the other person's interest. A sweet marriage starts by making good decisions. 
Good Decisions in Marriage
1. Make a decision that your home will be a haven, where people run back for peace, love, attention, and care. 
2. Your home should be Christ-centered. Jesus must be the Lord of your home. 
3. Look at what the Bible says about marriage and a godly family. 
4. Live by the Holy Spirit and not the flesh. 
By these decisions, you set your marriage on a firm foundation that cannot be moved. Make Jesus the centre of your values and decisions, knowing that you are his ambassador on earth. Jeremiah 29:11.
God's plan is that the home will be the place where his plan is revealed. In the family, the man creates the atmosphere where people experience the peace of God. Your home is not supposed to be a war zone. 
In God's plan, man is supposed to bring this Scripture to being. You are supposed to be a replica of God to your children.
In a God-centered marriage, men and women are equal. The female was already in the man before she was created. They are equal in worth before God. Galatians 3:28. 
A key is not more important than a padlock and vice-versa, and soup was not made to be eaten alone. Man and woman were created to be interdependent; one can't survive without the other. The wife makes the home flow.

title: Our Children, Our Responsibility By Pastor Sarah Omakwu || FIRST SERVICE || 31052026
description:
Our children are not just the future of the Church; they are our responsibility today.

In this powerful Children's Day message, we are reminded that raising godly children is not a task to be left to schools or churches alone. God has entrusted parents, especially fathers, with the responsibility of teaching, guiding, discipling, and modeling a life that reflects Christ.

Drawing from scriptures such as Malachi 2:15, Deuteronomy 6:6-7, Psalm 127, and Mark 10:13-16, this message highlights the importance of intentional parenting, spiritual leadership at home, and active involvement in children's ministry.

Key lessons from this message:
* Why children are a gift and a reward from God
* The biblical responsibility of parents in raising godly offspring
* The critical role fathers play in shaping the spiritual lives of their children
* Why children's ministry is kingdom work
* How strong children become strong families and strong societies
* The danger of leaving children's development to the world
* Practical ways parents can disciple their children daily
* Why the entire church must participate in raising the next generation

Whether you are a parent, grandparent, youth leader, teacher, or church member, this message will challenge and inspire you to invest in the lives of children and secure a godly future for generations to come.

Watch, share, and join the mission of raising children who will stand for Christ in their generation.

description:
Scripture: Hebrews 4:14-16; 1 Timothy 2:5-6
Jesus is not just any priest; He is our great high priest. 
Who is a priest?
He is someone appointed by God to stand before Him on behalf of the people. He serves as the mediator between God and man. What better high priest do we need than Christ Jesus. Hebrews 5:1; Hebrews 3:1. 
Jesus is the High Priest of our faith.
Why do we need a priest?
God cannot behold iniquity, so He had to create an office of the priest to mediate between Him and man. The priest offers sacrifices for his sin and that of the people. A sinful man could not approach God, so a priest was needed to stand on his behalf. 
How is Jesus different from other priests?
1. Earthly priests were sinners but Jesus was sinless. He went once to offer the sacrifice for the sins of the whole world. Hebrews 7:26-27
2. Other priests offered animals but Jesus offered Himself. He not only became the High Priest but the sacrifice. Hebrews 9:12. 
3. Other priests offered repeated sacrifices; Jesus offered only one sacrifice. Hebrews 10:11-12.
4. Other priests died; Jesus lives forever. Hebrews 7:23-24
5. Other priests ministered in earthly tabernacles; Jesus ministers in the heavenly tabernacle. Hebrews 9:11
6. Other priests provided limited access; Jesus gives direct access. Matthew 27:51; Hebrews 4:16
7. Other priests were from the Order of Aaron; Jesus is from the Order of Melchizedek. They were appointed from lineage but Jesus was appointed from heaven. Therefore, He has superior blessings. Hebrews 7:17 See less#fwc  #sermon  #gospel #theword

Scripture: Isaiah 9:6-7; Matthew 2:1-2; John 18:33-37; Revelations 19:11-16
Who is a King?
A king is a sovereign ruler with supreme authority over a territory. His word is law. Every king has a domain called kingdom. 
In scripture, kingship speaks of authority, dominion, government, ownership, rule, protection. A true king shapes culture, determines direction and commands allegiance.
How is Jesus different from other kings?
1. His kingdom is spiritual and eternal: Earthly kingdoms rise and fall, but Christ’s kingdom is spiritual, eternal and unshakeable. Psalm 144:13; Daniel 7:14
2. He rules with righteousness and justice: Many kings rule with oppression, fear and manipulation, but Jesus rules with holiness, mercy, righteousness and justice. 
3. Jesus truly serves and serves till death: Other kings want to be served, but Jesus serves the people. He still serves as intercessor. Mark 10:45; John 15:13
4. He is sinless: Every king has a fault and some are monsters, but Jesus was/is sinless. 1 Peter 2:22.

title: The Humanity of Jesus (2): Why It Matters.By Pastor Wilson Akubo || 1ST SERVICE || 19042026
description:
Last week, we established that Jesus is fully God and fully man. Today, we look at why His humanity is essential.
(SIGNIFICANCE OF JESUS’ HUMANITY) -Why Jesus Became Human
1. To enable Him identity with our daily realities - (Hebrews 4:15)- Jesus experienced life like we do, so He truly understands our struggles. He is not distant, He relates to our pain.
2. To give us a pattern to follow- (1 Peter 2:21)
   Jesus showed us how to live. His life is the pattern we are called to follow. Christianity is not just belief, it’s transformation into His likeness.
3. To give Him legal authority to operate on earth (Psalm 115:16)- Since dominion on earth was given to man, Jesus became human to operate within that system. Today, God still works through people, we are part of His eyes and legs to carry out His plans on earth.
4. To make Him the perfect mediator (1 Timothy 2:5)-As both God and man, Jesus bridges the gap between us and God, giving us direct and confident access to Him.
5. To allow us experience  God fully - (Hebrews 1:3) Through Jesus, we don’t just learn about God, we experience Him fully.
6. To gives us hope for future resurrection(1 Corinthians 15:20)- His resurrection assures ours. Death is not the end, but the doorway to eternal life.
7. To make His death possible -God cannot die, but as man, Jesus could. His sacrifice paid for our sins and secured our redemption.
Jesus became human so we could live fully and rightly. His coming is rooted in love, He understands you, walks with you, and invites you into the life God designed for you.

SPONTANEOUS WORSHIP AT TY BELLO'S FT. TOPE ALABI in IMOLE DE  with TY BELLO, OLASEHINDE OLUWASEGUNFUNMI, AFOLABI JOHNSON, ADEJUMOKE OSHOBOKE and GEORGE:

In 2015, I began spontaneous worship sessions on Thursdays , the sessions were very simple .. just me and David Nkennor and then George making music for the Audience of one .. Over the years I’ve had some amazing people join me in these sessions .. so Thursday’s are my favorite days ...meeting and fellowship in God’s presence, singing new and unwritten songs and so that others can join in worship ,.The Spirit of Light Album with Tope Alabi is the product of one of these unscripted meetings. The album is a spontaneous worship session with seventeen fresh songs performed live over a three-hour period. Imole De is the heart cry for everyone to come into God’s light. These are very dark days. Yet, it’s clear that the love of God passionately reaches out to humanity. To every man, God has made Himself available as “Father, Saviour, and Friend.He is near to each and every one of us; willing and able to save and deliver.
What a privilege to be able to reach out for Him.

title: Sechsfach-Mord von Stade: Migrations-Aktivistin fuhr das Fluchtauto | NIUS Live
description:
Stade: Sechs Menschen sind tot. Erschossen von einem Mann, der aus Rache handelte – weil der Staat ihm sein Kind entzogen hatte, um es zu schützen. Die Tatwaffe: eine Beretta, wenige Tage zuvor für 4.000 Euro gekauft. 

Und dann kommt heraus, wer am Steuer des Fluchtwagens saß: Eine 65-jährige Migrationsaktivistin, deren Lobbyverband nach NIUS-Informationen 2025 und 2026 rund 900.000 Euro aus dem Bundesprogramm „Demokratie leben“ erhalten haben soll. Sie soll den Täter noch wenige Tage vor der Tat in einem 20-seitigen Schreiben als „missverstandenen, fürsorglichen Vater“ verteidigt haben.

Während die Angehörigen der Opfer trauern, postet Bundeskanzler Merz einen knappen Kondolenz-Tweet, Justizministerin Hubig teilt entspannte Instagram-Bilder von Berlin und ARD und ZDF blenden die eigentlichen Hintergründe der Tat fast vollständig aus. Von einem "Sorgerechtsstreit" ist die Rede, wo es in Wahrheit um Rache an staatlichen Institutionen ging.

Bei NIUS Live sprachen NIUS-Chefredakteur Julian Reichelt, die stellv. NIUS-Chefredakteurin Pauline Voss und NIUS-Kolumnist Gunnar Schupelius mit Moderator Norbert Dobeleit über das Thema.

description:

THE ALAN PARSONS SYMPHONIC PROJECT “LIVE IN COLOMBIA” - AVAILABLE AS DVD, BLU-RAY, 2-CD DIGIPAK, 3 VINYL GATEFOLD AND DIGITAL 

On the evening of August 31st, 2013, a large crowd gathered at Parque Pies Descalzos in Medellín, Colombia. When Alan Parsons appeared on stage, along with the Medellín Philharmonic Orchestra and his  band the audience  went wild. This is an audio visual  document of that incredible evening.

THE ALAN PARSONS SYMPHONIC PROJECT “Live in Colombia” is available now on earMUSIC as DVD, Blu-ray, 2-CD digipak, 3 x Vinyl, and download. 

Alan Parsons was 19 years old when he landed a job at the world famous Abbey Road Studios, an important first step on his journey to becoming a world class engineer, producer and artist. Following his beginnings with George Martin and The Beatles, his contribution to Pink Floyd’s classic ‘The Dark Side Of The Moon’ earned him worldwide attention. As a producer he had many hits with Pilot, John Miles, Ambrosia and Al Stewart. Together with his manager and creative partner at the time, Eric Woolfson, he developed the Alan Parsons Project. 

Following their debut album “Tales Of Mystery And Imagination“ (1976), they released a series of hit albums; namely  “I Robot” (1977), “Pyramid” (1978), “The Turn of a Friendly Card” (1980), “Eye in the Sky” (1982), “Ammonia Avenue” (1984), “Vulture Culture” (1985), “Stereotomy” (1986) and “Gaudi” (1987). 

Then Parsons and Woolfson called it a day, but Parsons had ambitions to perform the amazing music live. Now to the great delight of his fans, for the first time on a live video and audio recording, THE ALAN PARSONS SYMPHONIC PROJECT combines the talents of his amazing band with the lush sound of a 70-piece symphony orchestra, creating a very special show with unmatched quality. Together, they revitalize hits such as “Eye In The Sky“, “Don’t Answer Me“ and “Sirius“. 

The lineup consists of Alan Parsons on acoustic guitar, keys, and vocals, P.J. Olsson (lead vocals), Alastair Greene (guitar, vocals), Guy Erez (bass, vocals), Danny Thompson (drums, vocals), Tom Brooks (keyboards, vocals) und Todd Cooper (saxophone, guitar, percussion, vocals). Alejandro Posada conducts the Medellin Philharmonic Orchestra

Queenstown, New Zealand is known as the adventure capital of the world, and for good reason! Nestled in the heart of the Southern Alps on the shores of Lake Wakatipu, Queenstown offers visitors breathtaking scenery and a wide range of thrilling activities. In this video, we'll be sharing some of the best things to do in Queenstown, New Zealand.

First on our list is bungee jumping. Queenstown is the birthplace of commercial bungee jumping, and you can experience this adrenaline-pumping activity at the Kawarau Bridge, which is the world's first commercial bungee site. You can also try the Nevis Bungy, which is the highest bungee jump in New Zealand, or the Ledge Bungy, which allows you to jump from a platform suspended 400 meters above Queenstown.

If you're a fan of winter sports, Queenstown is a must-visit destination. The city has four major ski fields, including Coronet Peak, which is only a 20-minute drive from the city center. You can also try your hand at snowboarding, snowshoeing, or even ice climbing.

For a more laid-back activity, take a scenic cruise on Lake Wakatipu. You can relax on board and take in the stunning scenery, or get off at one of the stops along the way and explore the local area. You can also take a ride on the iconic TSS Earnslaw steamship, which has been cruising on the lake for over 100 years.

For a bird's eye view of Queenstown, take a gondola ride up to the Skyline Queenstown complex. From here, you can enjoy panoramic views of the city and the surrounding mountains. You can also take a thrilling ride on the Skyline Luge, which is a gravity-driven karting experience.

If you're a Lord of the Rings fan, don't miss the chance to visit some of the film's iconic locations. You can take a tour of the filming locations, including the Misty Mountains and the Pillars of the Kings, or visit the Weta Workshop, which created many of the film's props and costumes.

Last but not least, foodies will love the vibrant dining scene in Queenstown. The city has a wide range of restaurants and cafes, serving everything from traditional New Zealand cuisine to international dishes. Be sure to try some of the local specialties, such as venison, lamb, and seafood.

In conclusion, Queenstown is a city that offers a unique blend of natural beauty, adventure, and culture.

title: Dancing Through the Valleys with Precision — Queenstown’s Stunning RNP Approaches
description:
Queenstown Airport is widely regarded as one of the most scenic — and demanding — approaches in the world. Surrounded by towering mountains and deep valleys, aircraft must follow a precisely curved descent path before touching down. Due to the challenging terrain, a conventional ILS (Instrument Landing System) is not available here, making these approaches even more unique.

In this video, aircraft from Air New Zealand, Qantas, and Virgin Australia execute the famous RNP (Required Navigation Performance) approach into Queenstown — a highly accurate, GPS-guided procedure that allows pilots to safely “thread” through the valleys with remarkable precision.

Filmed over several days, this compilation captures a variety of aircraft descending through shifting clouds, turning between rugged peaks, and lining up for landing against one of the most breathtaking backdrops in aviation.

No music, no narration — just the raw sights and sounds of aircraft flying one of the most spectacular approaches in the world.

title: Queenstown: The Ultimate Destination In New Zealand's South Island
description:
Queenstown: The Ultimate Destination In New Zealand's South Island

#queenstown #southisland #newzealand #travel #drivingandfilming #queenstownnz 

Nestled on the shores of Lake Wakatipu and surrounded by the Remarkables mountain range, Queenstown is one of the most iconic travel destinations on New Zealand’s South Island. Known as the adventure capital of the world, Queenstown offers a range of activities and sights that appeal to thrill-seekers, nature lovers, and those looking for relaxation alike. With stunning landscapes, a vibrant culinary scene, and an array of outdoor activities, Queenstown is a must-visit destination for travelers.

1. Adventure Activities
Queenstown is synonymous with adventure sports. It’s the birthplace of bungee jumping, and Kawarau Bridge is the original site for thrill-seekers to take the plunge. Visitors can also experience skydiving, paragliding, and ziplining over stunning mountain and lake views. Additionally, the nearby Shotover River is famous for its jet boating experience, offering an adrenaline-pumping ride through narrow river canyons.

2. Skiing and Snowboarding
Queenstown is home to some of New Zealand's premier ski resorts, making it a haven for snow sports enthusiasts. In winter, Coronet Peak and The Remarkables ski fields offer world-class slopes for skiing, snowboarding, and snowshoeing. Each ski season, from June to October, the mountains come alive with both locals and tourists enjoying fresh powder and après-ski scenes.

3. Lake Wakatipu and Water Activities
Lake Wakatipu, New Zealand's longest lake, offers a stunning backdrop to the town and numerous water-based activities. From cruises on the historic TSS Earnslaw steamship to kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, and fishing, visitors can experience the serene beauty of Queenstown's waters. The lake also provides breathtaking sunset views, perfect for romantic outings or simply unwinding after a day of adventure.

4. Hiking and Nature Trails
Surrounded by scenic trails, Queenstown is a paradise for hiking and nature lovers. The Ben Lomond Track is one of the most popular hikes, rewarding climbers with panoramic views over Queenstown and the surrounding area. For a shorter hike, the Queenstown Hill Time Walk offers beautiful viewpoints over Lake Wakatipu and is suitable for families. Beyond Queenstown, Fiordland National Park and Milford Sound are accessible for day trips, offering some of the most dramatic landscapes in New Zealand.

5. Wine Tours and Culinary Experiences
The Central Otago wine region, famous for its Pinot Noir, is just a short drive from Queenstown, making it easy to embark on wine tours of the region’s renowned vineyards. Many wineries offer tastings and food pairings that showcase local produce. Queenstown itself has a vibrant culinary scene, with options ranging from fine dining to local favorites like the iconic Fergburger. There’s also an impressive selection of craft breweries and bars where visitors can unwind and enjoy the local flavors.

6. Scenic Helicopter and Hot Air Balloon Tours
For a bird’s-eye view of Queenstown's majestic landscapes, helicopter tours and hot air balloon rides are a must. Helicopter tours offer a unique way to explore nearby attractions like Milford Sound and Mount Aspiring National Park, allowing visitors to land on mountain peaks and witness glaciers up close. Hot air balloon rides, meanwhile, provide an enchanting and peaceful way to see Queenstown from above, with early morning flights offering stunning sunrise views.

7. Accommodation and Luxury Stays
Queenstown has a wide range of accommodation options, from budget hostels to high-end luxury resorts. Lakeside hotels and resorts like The Rees Hotel and Eichardt’s Private Hotel offer stunning views of Lake Wakatipu. There are also many secluded luxury lodges, making Queenstown ideal for romantic getaways or family vacations.

8. Year-Round Destination
With so much to offer in every season, Queenstown is a year-round destination. In summer, the warmer weather is perfect for lake activities and hiking, while in autumn, Queenstown’s landscapes are transformed with vibrant foliage. Winter brings a wonderland for snow sports, and spring offers blooming wildflowers and fewer crowds.

9. Shopping and Nightlife
Queenstown also has an exciting nightlife and shopping scene. After a day of adventure, visitors can relax and enjoy lively bars, pubs, and nightclubs. For shopping, the town center is filled with boutique stores, local artisan shops, and markets where travelers can pick up unique souvenirs, art, and outdoor gear.

Queenstown combines natural beauty with adrenaline-fueled experiences, creating a unique, immersive destination that attracts millions of visitors from around the world. Whether you're looking to relax in luxury, conquer extreme sports, or explore some of New Zealand's most scenic landscapes, Queenstown truly is the ultimate destination in New Zealand's South Island.

You're standing on the edge of a 43-meter bridge above Lake Wakatipu, about to take the leap that'll define your entire New Zealand adventure. That's Queenstown for you. With only 3 days in New Zealand's adventure capital, most travelers make costly mistakes that leave them exhausted or missing the best experiences. This guide reveals exactly how to experience world-class adventure, hidden local gems, and Instagram-worthy moments without tourist traps. We're covering three perfectly planned days, insider booking strategies, and the one mistake that costs travelers $400. Let's dive in. 

DAY 1: GET YOUR BEARINGS 
Day one is all about orientation and easing into Queenstown's energy. Start the morning at 8 AM with the Skyline Gondola - and here's why this timing matters. Most tourists sleep in and hit the gondola around 10 AM when it's packed. Beat the crowds, get better photos, and you'll pay around $60 NZD for adults instead of fighting for space later. At the top, skip the overpriced restaurant and do two luge rides instead - one isn't enough. The views of The Remarkables mountain range from up here are what postcards are made of, and you'll understand why Queenstown's geography makes it perfect for adventure sports. The gondola terminal offers multiple viewing platforms, each providing different perspectives of the dramatic alpine landscape that surrounds this adventure capital. After descending, spend late morning exploring Queenstown Gardens. This isn't just a filler activity - the lakefront walk gives you perspective on distances and helps you plan the rest of your stay. Plus, it's free and offers some of the best photo opportunities with Lake Wakatipu as your backdrop. The gardens feature mature trees, open lawns perfect for picnics, and waterfront paths that showcase Queenstown's natural setting between mountains and lake. For lunch, head to Steamer Wharf area where you'll find several waterfront restaurants. Here's the local secret - many restaurants like Boardwalk or Finz have more casual takeaway options for approximately $35-40 NZD instead of their full dining service at around $60-70. Same quality, better views eating by the lake. Your afternoon centerpiece is the TSS Earnslaw steamship cruise to Walter Peak Farm. Book online in advance for the best rates - expect to pay roughly $75-85 NZD for the cruise only. This 90-minute experience gives you lake perspectives impossible to get from land, and the vintage steamship is genuinely historic, not a tourist reproduction. The coal-fired steam engine operates exactly as it did when launched in 1912. But before you book that expensive helicopter tour everyone talks about, save your money. The steamship views are spectacular, and you'll want that helicopter budget for day two's adventures. The Walter Peak experience includes sheep shearing demonstrations and farm tours that provide insight into New Zealand's agricultural heritage. Evening is for exploring Queenstown's compact city center. Dinner at Rātā restaurant if you're splurging - Chef Josh Emett's New Zealand cuisine is worth approximately $95 per person. Budget option? Head to Devil Burger for about $32 NZD - locals consistently rate it above the tourist-trap restaurants on the main strip. End day one with drinks at Atlas Beer Café. Local craft beers, reasonable prices, and you'll overhear conversations about hidden gems for the next two days. 

DAY 2: ADVENTURE DAY 
Day two is where Queenstown earns its adventure capital reputation. Start early - 9 AM booking for Shotover Jet. Here's the insider strategy: book directly through their website three days in advance and pay $169 NZD for adults. The famous 360-degree spins in narrow canyon walls deliver exactly the adrenaline rush you came for. Now here's something nobody tells you about the timing. Most adventure companies offer morning and afternoon slots, but morning activities pair better with afternoon scenic experiences. Your body processes adrenaline better when you're fresh, and afternoon light is superior for photography on scenic activities. This strategic timing also means you'll have energy for multiple activities without the fatigue that builds throughout the day. If bungee jumping is on your list, AJ Hackett Kawarau Gorge is the original commercial bungee site.

title: Queenstown’s Most Beautiful Season 🍁 Peak Autumn Colours 2026 | New Zealand 4K Walking Tour
description:
Experience the magic of autumn in Queenstown New Zealand during peak autumn colours in this stunning 4K walking tour filmed around noon on 30 April 2026. We begin on Brecon Street, walking down the famous stairs into the vibrant town centre, where brilliant red maple trees line the streets and transform Queenstown into a sea of fiery autumn colours under the bright midday light.

Our walk continues through bustling Shotover Street, passing the world-famous Fergburger — Queenstown’s most popular burger spot — along with its busy bakery and bar, where crowds queue for their food during the busy autumn season. From there, we wander through the colourful town centre mall, one of the most beautiful streets in Queenstown during autumn, before reaching the shores of Lake Wakatipu at Queenstown Beach.

Queenstown is known as the Adventure Capital of the World and is one of New Zealand’s most famous alpine resort towns. Surrounded by the Remarkables mountain range and located beside the crystal-clear waters of Lake Wakatipu, Queenstown attracts visitors from around the world for its breathtaking scenery, four distinct seasons, skiing, hiking, jet boating, and vibrant atmosphere. Autumn is considered one of the best times to visit, when the town becomes covered in spectacular red, orange, and golden leaves.

Along the waterfront, the historic TSS Earnslaw — now over 113 years old — returns gracefully across the lake, adding timeless charm to the spectacular autumn scenery. Restaurants, cafés, and bars along the lakefront are full of people enjoying the lively atmosphere beneath glowing yellow, orange, and red trees.

We continue our relaxing walk along Beach Street and Church Street, arriving at the beautiful St Peter's Anglican Church, where a couple is taking wedding photos among the autumn leaves — a perfect reflection of Queenstown’s romantic autumn season.

The tour ends back at Queenstown Beach with peaceful lake and mountain views surrounded by the incredible colours of autumn. Sit back, relax, and enjoy one of the most beautiful autumn walks in New Zealand in full 4K UHD.

title: Queenstown Airport Launches New $50,000 Community Fund
description:
The new Queenstown Airport Community Fund, administered on our behalf by the Wakatipu Community Foundation, will distribute $50,000 in annual grants ranging from $1,000 to $5,000 to local charities and community organisations doing great work in the Queenstown Lakes and Central Otago districts.

As a majority community-owned organisation, it’s important to us to give back. Queenstown Airport already contributes $150,000 through our annual partnerships programme; this new fund aims to extend our support further and empower grassroots organisations to achieve their goals for our community.

Applications are open from 3rd March to 7th April, and if your organisation is making a difference in our region, we encourage you to apply. 

For more details and the online application form, visit the Wakatipu Community Foundation’s website: https://www.wakatipucommunityfoundation.co.nz/queenstownairportcommunityfund

title: Full-Guide to living and working in Queenstown, New Zealand (what to expect)
description:
What is it really like living and working in Queenstown, New Zealand?

Is it over-rated, under-rated or just right? Well, in today's video we will dive into everything from finding housing, purchasing a 15 year old car, finding work, what the cost of living looks like, what your lifestyle might look like basing here versus passing through as a tourist and much more! We will take what we learned living here for about a year and try to help you have a better idea of what to expect before you move to this wonderful destination! 

Queenstown, New Zealand, is a lively and beautiful mountain town and probably the most famous tourist destination in all of New Zealand. If you're from the USA you could compare it to Aspen or Vail in the state of Colorado. {this is where I spent some time living in 2016 and Queenstown shares some similarities to life in Colorado's mountain towns.} 

From adventure activities to wine tasting to hiking you really can't get bored in this amazing area located amongst the Southern Alps. I had been here in 2015 passing through as a backpacker but this time my partner and I would choose to base here for about a year's time while she took advantage of the working holiday visa opportunity. We both enjoyed most of the things that this amazing location has to offer while getting to explore this area more deeply "almost like being long-time Queenstown locals".

From appreciating the breath-taking views of the Remarkables' on my daily walk to the gym, to multiple visits to Ferg Burger {the local infamous burger spot that might be better than Five Guys?}, to road trips to places like Glenorchy, Mt. Cook National Park, Haast, Bluff and more you really have to try hard to be bored in this place!

description:
The all-new XK continues the Jaguar tradition of beautiful, powerful, ground-breaking sports cars, but behind its stunning looks, it bristles with practical, intuitive, modern technology, clearly focussed on enhancing the driving experience. It delivers significant improvements in performance, dynamics, safety, exterior and interior design and equipment, and product quality. When it is launched in early 2006, this first of the next generation of Jaguars will become the sporting flagship of the Jaguar brand.

By starting with a blank canvas, Jaguar was able to make use of the latest aerospace technologies alongside more traditional Jaguar skills to create a luxurious, powerful, highly advanced sports car. A major key to the all-new XK's character is Jaguar's industry-leading aluminium monocoque body structure, introduced with the latest XJ saloons.


With this unique high-tech construction method, the all-new XK's bodyshell is 31 percent stiffer than the previous XK's and significantly offers a 10 percent improvement in power to weight ratio. The all-new XK is up to 90 percent stiffer and 180kg lighter than key rivals, with a kerb weight of just 1595kg.

title: Wet Footwell Nightmare FIXED for Jaguar XK x150 Owners!
description:
The infamous Duck Bill in the Jaguar XK x150 is an “Evaporator drain tube” that allows the condensation to drain from the air conditioning unit. Do yourself a favor and buy this Book: Jaguar New XK 2005-2014: The Essential Buyer’s Guide. https://amzn.to/3XNLHkY
The issue is that the end of the drain tube, called a Duck Bill, due to it’s shape, gets blocked resulting in the condensation running back towards the air-conditioning unit and leaking into the passenger's footwell.
The biggest problem is that although the duck bill itself is only a few dollars, the recommended way to access it the drain is to remove the whole dash, resulting in an enormous labor cost. 
There have been many clever ways to solve the issue, from cutting the end of the tube with a long-bladed knife to squirting soapy water to try to clear the blockage.
You can see the duckbill from the top of the engine using an endoscope camera. You will most likely need to use the mirror attachment. This is the entry point for the endoscope camera

description:
🚘 Curiosidades sobre a F-1000 Deserter XK:

1. Não era feita pela Ford

Essa versão Deserter XK não saía da linha oficial da Ford. Era uma conversão feita por empresas especializadas, como a Engesa, Sahara Veículos ou oficinas de customização sob encomenda. Elas transformavam a F-1000 em veículos de luxo ou estilo militar, com carroceria exclusiva.

2. Inspiração militar

O nome “Deserter” (Desertor, em inglês) e o estilo robusto eram uma homenagem aos veículos militares off-road, com visual mais parrudo e agressivo, inspirado no Ford Bronco ou Jeep Wagoneer.

3. Cabine dupla era um luxo na época

Essa picape tem 4 portas e cabine dupla, algo raro nos anos 80/90 no Brasil, onde a maioria das picapes era cabine simples. Ela era voltada para fazendeiros ou empresários que queriam conforto sem abrir mão da força bruta.

4. Equipamento de série de alto padrão

Muitas vinham com ar-condicionado, direção hidráulica, bancos confortáveis e acabamento em madeira ou couro, algo extremamente incomum para picapes diesel da época.

5. Motor MWM Diesel 229 ou 4.07

Algumas versões traziam o confiável motor MWM, famoso pela durabilidade e facilidade de manutenção, tornando essa F-1000 uma verdadeira guerreira das estradas e fazendas brasileiras.

6. Hoje é uma raridade valorizada

Modelos bem conservados como o da foto valem alto no mercado de colecionadores, podendo passar de R$ 100 mil em alguns casos, dependendo do estado de conservação e originalidade.

title: Nuvvu Vijilesthey Full Video Song | Simhadri | Jr. NTR | Bhoomika | S.S.Rajamouli | ETV Cinema
description:
An orphan and good-hearted lad Simhadri (NTR) is 'adopted' and grows up under Ram Bhupal Varma's (Nassar) family care in Visakhapatnam. The bond they share is like a father and son. Kasturi (Ankita) is the granddaughter (youngest daughter's daughter) of Ram Bhupal Varma. Kasturi likes Simhadri a lot. Once a week, Simhadri visits a mentally challenged girl called Indu (Bhoomika Chawla). He entertains her and provides money to her caretakers (Rallapally and Ragini).

When Ram Bhupal Varma and his wife discover Kasturi's wish to marry Simhadri, Ram Bhupal Varma decides to get them married. He makes a formal announcement to officially adopt Simhadri. At this time, it is revealed that Simhadri is very close to Indu. The alliance breaks off when Simhadri refuses to leave Indu (who is suspected to be his mistress).

Meanwhile, two separate groups are in search of Simhadri. They find him at the banks of Godavari River along with Indu. In the ensuing confrontation between one group (gangsters) and Simhadri, Indu gets injured. Simhadri is helped by the second group who call him 'Singamalai Anna' (Brother Singamalai). When Indu comes back to her senses, she remembers her past and the first thing she does is stab Simhadri with an iron pole. Simhadri is hospitalized in critical condition. Then we see many buses carrying hoards of people demanding to see 'Singamalai Anna'. The leader of the second group who was searching for Simhadri explains 'Singamalai Anna' story in a flashback.

In the flashback, it is revealed that Ram Bhupal Varma's oldest daughter Saraswati (Seeta) elopes with her lover, a Keralite named Aravind (Bhanu Chandar). After some harsh words and saddened over Ram Bhupal Varma's rejection over her choice to marry her love, they both settle in Kerala. Learning of the sadness surrounding Ram Bhupal Varma and his wife, Simhadri takes up the job of uniting the family and visits Thiruvananthapuram. He joins the medical and spiritual therapy spa operated by Saraswati and her family under the disguise of a patient.

He finds that Indu is the first granddaughter of Ram Bhupal Varma. He convinces the separated family to reunite and ask for forgiveness. During this time, Saraswati is killed by a local goon Bala Nair (Rahul Dev). A don named Bhai Saab (Mukesh Rishi) controls the mafia of Kerala. Nair and Bhai Saab belong to the same mafia. Simhadri takes law into his hands and eradicates Bala Nair and his small gang in Kerala. The local Kerala people starts calling him 'Singamalai'. In the ensuing scenes, Simhadri finds himself developing into "Singamalai," eradicating Bhai Saab's network and illegal activities. Indu finds herself alone and constantly worrying about him. She proposes to her father that they should return to Andhra Pradesh because she cannot stand their home without her mother and Simhadri ignores her now.

Indu and Aravind decide to return to Visakhapatnam. Simhadri receives a call that Indu's father is carrying a bomb in his briefcase. Aravind is seen rushing to catch a moving train and Indu was about to lend him a hand. Unable to warn him, Simhadri has two choices: to let Indu's father die, so people on the train can live or let the bomb kill everyone on board, including the father and Indu herself.

Simhadri chooses to the first option. As soon as Aravind catches the train bar handle, Simhadri shoots him in the back. Surprised at Simhadri's action; Indu jumps off the train to catch her falling father and she gets hit her head against a pole, causing her amnesia and become mentally challenged. After the flashback ends, people are seen and heard chanting Singamalai Singamalai outside the hospital. Bhai Saab and his men arrive at the hospital to finish off Simhadri. But Simhadri has gained consciousness with the help of his friends, police and family (now reunited), he takes down Bhai Saab and his army.

title: NF - Hope [ Lirik Terjemahan ]
description:
“HOPE” is NF’s first release of 2023 and his first release since his March 2021 mixtape, CLOUDS (THE MIXTAPE), it serves as the lead single, intro and title track of his fifth studio album HOPE, which is set to release on April 7th, 2023.

In this track, NF introduces the audience to a new side of him, a side that’s hopeful and that has come a long way.

In the music video there are two versions of NF, one is wearing all white which represents a changed version of himself, this version has found hope and is trying to be a better version of NF than his past self. The other version of NF that is seen in the music video is the dark version of him, dressed in all back, this version is the NF that’s been seen ever since it was introduced on the cover of NF’s second album Therapy Session.

At the beginning of the video NF in white is seen sitting alone on a raft drifting in the middle of an ocean. This could be a new way for Nate to perceive his own mind: the ocean would symbolize the thoughts of Nate. And the raft would be the foundations he built by working on himself and which have allowed to raise this new Nate on the surface.

At 2:22 in the video, NF is standing next to the dark side of himself, holding a map, which is a callback to his March 2019 song “The Search”, where he says:

"I’m lookin' for the map to hope, you seen it? (You seen it?)"

In the music video for The Search, NF is wearing all black. By also looking at the name of the song, “HOPE”, NF demonstrates he’s found the map he has always been looking for, or simply put, he’s finally found hope. As he is looking at the map, his dark side follows him around, pointing him in the wrong direction. Confused, he follows the directions until he winds up right back where he started, as he walks away looking at his map, his dark side comes up behind him and pushes the bright side of NF into the sand, causing him to fall inside of a mansion.
As Nate picks himself up from the floor, his March 2015 song “Mansion” starts playing as he walks around inside looking for an exit. This is a visual representation of NF’s mind as he’s always referred to it as a mansion, the mansion is where fear, his burdens, pain, hurt and several other emotions reside. This symbolizes that NF has finally been able to escape his mind and not let the things he used to carry around and hold onto keep him captive.

As NF walks around inside the mansion, he finds a door that he opens only to see that inside is fear and his past burdens trying to get him to come back, he quickly closes it. He finds another door that he opens and sees a version of himself standing inside a cage holding a set of keys. This is a callback to his third album Perception where NF is shown on the cover standing inside of a cage. As NF gets closer the version of himself inside the cage takes his hat off revealing gray hair. Want to know how to backtest on FX Replay? In this video, I’ll show you how to use FX Replay to test a trading strategy, replay historical price action, practice entries and exits, and review your trading performance step by step.

How to backtest on FX Replay

How to place practice trades

How to review your backtest results
How to improve your trading with replay practice

FX Replay helps traders practice by replaying historical market data as if it were happening live. This lets you test your strategy without risking real money and helps you understand how your setup performs across different market conditions.

To backtest properly, start by choosing one clear strategy. Define your entry rules, exit rules, stop loss, take profit, risk per trade, trading session, and market conditions before starting the replay.

Once your rules are clear, use FX Replay to move candle by candle, take practice trades, record your results, and review what worked or failed. The goal is to follow the same plan every time instead of changing your rules during the test.

After finishing your backtest, review your win rate, risk to reward, average profit, average loss, best setups, worst setups, and common mistakes. This helps you know whether your strategy needs improvement before using it in live trading.

Released ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026™, **DNA** captures the passion, unity, and emotion of football’s biggest celebration. The track reflects the spirit of the first FIFA World Cup to be hosted across three nations and 16 cities, with 48 teams set to compete on the sport’s grandest stage.

More than just an anthem, **DNA** represents the moment when the roar of the crowd becomes one voice, honoring football as a force that transcends borders, cultures, and generations.

To celebrate its global release, **Andrea Bocelli** and **EJAE** will perform **DNA** live for the first time during the opening ceremony in Mexico City on June 11. The performance will set the stage for a historic tournament spanning Canada, Mexico, and the United States, united by a shared love of the beautiful game and the millions of fans it inspires around the world.

From the album Bad, released August 31, 1987
Released as a single October 21, 1988

THE SHORT FILM
Director: Colin Chilvers
Primary Production Location: Los Angeles, California

Michael Jackson's short film for "Smooth Criminal" was the sixth of nine short films produced for recordings from Bad, one of the best selling albums of all time. The "Smooth Criminal" single hit No. 1 in Spain and The Netherlands and reached the Top 10 in the UnitedStates, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Ireland and Switzerland. In the United States, "Smooth Criminal" reached the Top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100-the sixth single from Bad to do so-as well as Billboard's Hot Dance Club Play and Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Singles charts.

In addition to being a standalone short film, "Smooth Criminal" became the centerpiece of Michael's most ambitious film project at the time, Moonwalker, a feature-length film that was released theatrically in various countries outside of the United States. In the "Smooth Criminal" portion of the film, Michael and his friends face off against the notorious drug lord Mr. Big (Joe Pesci) and attempt to foil his plot to get the children of the world hooked on drugs-but of course, in the end, Michael defeats the villain.

The musical portion of "Smooth Criminal" takes place in the magical "Club '30s," where Michael instructed his friends to meet him. While Katie (Kellie Parker), Zeke (Brandon Adams) and Sean (Sean Lennon) find the club to belong abandoned, Club '30s springs to life when Michael shows up, wearing a blue and white pinstripe suit and fedora.

As the kids watch through the window, Michael flips a coin into the jukebox and leads the club patrons through a dazzling performance to "Smooth Criminal." Here, Michael shows off updated versions of his signature dance moves. He also debuts one of his most iconic dance moves: the "anti-gravity lean," a seemingly impossible move.

"Smooth Criminal" is the seventh single from American recording artist Michael Jackson's
1987 Bad album. The song contains fast-
paced beat intertwined with Jackson's lyrics
about a woman named Annie, who has been
violently attacked in her apartment by a
"Smooth" assailant. First broadcast on
television as a video in early October, it was
released as a single on October 21, 1988, and
peaked at number seven on the Billboard Hot
100. it was re-released on April 10 2006, as a
part of the Visionary. The Video Singles box
set. The re-released Visionary single charted
at number 19 in the UK. The song is one of
Jackson's signature songs, and has appeared
on numerous greatest hits album, including Number Ones, The Essential Michael Jackson,
Michael Jackson: Ultimate Collection,
King Of Pop, This is It, and Immortal.

The song serves as the theme song to
Jackson's 1988 film Moonwalker, and plays as
the background soundtrack in a section of the
video game Michael Jackson's Moonwalker.

"Smooth Criminal" é uma canção do cantor norte-americano Michael Jackson, lançada em 14 de novembro de 1988 pela Epic Records como o sétimo single de seu sétimo álbum de estúdio Bad (1987). A canção, escrita e composta por Jackson, e produzida por Jackson e Quincy Jones, apresenta uma batida rápida, com letra sobre uma mulher que foi atacada em seu apartamento por um "criminoso silente". O refrão "Annie, are you OK?" foi inspirado por Resusci Anne, um manequim usado no treinamento de RCP.

"Smooth Criminal" alcançou a posição de número sete na parada norte-americana Billboard Hot 100, tornando-se o sexto single de Bad a chegar ao top 10. A canção também alcançou a segunda colocação na parada Billboard Hot Black Singles. "Smooth Criminal" recebeu certificação de platina duplo pela Associação Americana da Indústria de Gravação (RIAA). O single alcançou a posição de número um na Bélgica, Islândia, Holanda e Espanha. Embora "Smooth Criminal" não tenha sido um dos singles número um da Billboard Hot 100, em críticas retrospectivas, ela é considerada uma das melhores canções de Bad, e uma das canções representativas de Jackson.[1] A canção já apareceu em diversas compilações e foi cantada em todas as turnês solo de Jackson.

O videoclipe de "Smooth Criminal" estreou na MTV em 13 de outubro de 1988. O vídeo é a peça central do filme Moonwalker de 1988. O cenário com influência da década de 1930, o terno e fedora brancos de Jackson prestam homenagem ao filme de comédia musical estrelado por Fred Astaire, The Band Wagon (1953). No vídeo, Jackson e os dançarinos realizam um "movimento anti-gravidade" que parece fisicamente impossível.

🔫🎩 -:{ HISTORIA }:- 🎩🔫
La idea le vino a la mente a Michael en 1984. "Smooth Criminal" fue grabada entre el otoño de 1985 y el 25 de junio de 1987. Evolucionó a partir de otra canción de Jackson con temática criminal, "Al Capone", cuyas melodías se parecen a las de "Smooth Criminal". Michael mencionó que la canción casi no llegó a Bad.

Michael basó esta canción en películas de mafia y criminales de los años 1940-1950. La frase "Annie, are you okay?" repetida en el coro de la canción hace referencia a una práctica de entrenamiento utilizada en las clases de reanimación cardiopulmonar (comúnmente conocida como RCP). Annie es un maniquí de práctica ampliamente utilizado en los países de habla inglesa, y a los estudiantes se les enseña a evaluar el estado del receptor de la RCP antes de realizar la técnica; esto se hace comúnmente instruyendo a los aprendices a hacer la pregunta, "Annie, are you okay?" antes de administrar la RCP para determinar si el paciente está consciente y responde o no. Durante la grabación de "Bad", se sabía que Michael había tomado una clase de RCP.

Oniyide Azeez (born 21 April 2000),[3][4] professionally known as Zinoleesky, is a Nigerian singer, songwriter and rapper.[5][6] His rise to fame began with the launch of his debut album Chrome Eccentric featuring hit tracks like "Ma Pariwo" and "Kilofeshe.".[7][8]

Early life
Zinoleesky, born on April 21, 2000, in Lagos State to Mr. and Mrs. Oniyide, originally hails from Ogun State, Nigeria.[9][10] Raised in Agege, Lagos State, Azeez attended Lively Kiddies Nursery and Primary School for his primary education, and later, State high School Oyewole Agege, Lagos State, for his secondary education.[11]

Career
Zinoleesky found his love for music during his adolescence, initially venturing into freestyle rap. However, his breakthrough came in 2017 when his videos gained viral traction online, propelling him to popularity.[12][13]

Several reports showed that he was offered a record deal by Davido's DMW label but refused to accept the offer and chose to work as an independent artist.[14][15] On 23 December 2019, he was signed to the record label "Marlian Records" which is owned and managed by Nigerian singer, Naira Marley.[16]

Zinoleesky released his debut studio album titled Chrome Eccentric in 2020, a year after signing with Marlian Records. The album comprised six tracks, including the songs "Mapariwo" and "Kilofeshe".[17] In September 2020, Ma Pariwo ranked as No. 14 on Apple Music Chart and No. 12 on YouTube Chart.[18]

A year after the release of his first album, Zinoleesky created a remix to the hit song "Kilofeshe" featuring Maryorkun and South African singer, Busiswa.[19]

In December 2022, he released his first EP Grit and Lust, containing tracks such as "Call of Duty" and "YanYanYan".[20]

PVB Laminated glass is a type of safety glass that is made by sandwiching a layer of polyvinyl butyral (simplified as PVB) between two layers of glass. PVB laminated glass is always used in car windshields, side windows, and rear windows to provide added safety in the event of a collision and used in skylights, curtain walls, and other building applications to provide natural light while also protecting against UV rays and reducing noise.  Therefore, it is currently the most widely used interlayer material in architectural and automotive industries.

When buildings are demolished and automobiles are scrapped, a large amount of this type of PVB laminated glass will be produced, and PVB laminated glass has a high recycling value. The PVB laminated glass separation equipment provided by our company can completely separate glass and PVB film. The separated glass can be returned to the furnace for reproduction, and the PVB film can be directly used to make granules. 

The set of equipment is mainly divided into two parts: Part I, the PVB laminated glass is rolled by the upper and lower rollers of the glass roller press, and the glass on the waste laminated glass is rolled and broken into pieces while the PVB film is not damaged; Part 2, the rolled waste laminated glass are put into the drum of the PVB film separator, and the glass shards fall off the PVB film through the shaking of the drum, and fall from the small hole on the drum into the glass recycling box below the drum, so that the glass shards and PVB film are separated.
